questions.question: You launch an ordinary TPU-VM SSH command on worker zero of a multi-host slice, without another launcher. What can happen?
options: Google Cloud automatically merges the 4 Linux hosts into 1 host
Only that worker starts the command; distributed initialization or collectives can wait for the missing participants
The script runs four times faster
questions.explanation: An explicit launcher must start every participating process with compatible configuration. --worker=all is one Cloud TPU API method; other orchestrators can do the same job. Initialization, data ownership and collected worker receipts still require separate checks.
optionFeedback: An SSH command does not automatically launch Python on every worker. Use an explicit per-host launcher with matching configuration.

An explicit launcher must start every participating process with compatible configuration. --worker=all is one Cloud TPU API method; other orchestrators can do the same job. Initialization, data ownership and collected worker receipts still require separate checks.
Omitting participating workers cannot accelerate a collective that requires them. It can leave distributed initialization or communication waiting.
